instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor training room with black mats. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) is bent forward. On the right, the man in the white and blue t-shirt (R2) stands behind R1, holding him in a tight waist lock. R1 leans forward, extending his arm to maintain balance. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene with neutral colors.
